candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return tx.origin instead of the stored _owner.
Change owner() to return address(0) unconditionally.
Change owner() to return _msgSender() instead of stored _owner.
Require newOwner may be zero address removed, allowing ownership transfer to zero (renounce via transferOwnership).
Add an extra restriction preventing transfer of ownership to the caller (no-op if attempting self-transfer), blocking such transfers.
Tighten onlyOwner to compare against msg.sender directly instead of _msgSender(), which can change behavior if _msgSender is overridden.
